id: You are about to enter a battle with an Ultra Beast that will be unobtainable until the post game if it is not caught here. Save?
en: You are about to enter a battle with an Ultra Beast that will be unobtainable until the post game if it is not caught here. Save?
it: Stai per affrontare un'Ultracreatura che, se non la catturi qui, non sarà ottenibile fino al post-game. Vuoi salvare?

id: \bFaba: Good, you brought the Cosmog. While I have learned a lot more about it I sadly have to keep it to myself. And take it for myself. Hand it over!
en: \bFaba: Good, you brought the Cosmog. While I have learned a lot more about it I sadly have to keep it to myself. And take it for myself. Hand it over!
it: \bVicio: Bene, hai portato il Cosmog. Anche se ho scoperto molto di più su di lui, purtroppo devo tenerlo per me. E prenderlo per me. Consegnamelo!
